schema.name: uq_asset_contents_path_live
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_asset_contents_path_live ON asset_contents (path) WHERE is_missing = 0

schema.name: alembic_version
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE alembic_version (version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

schema.name: asset_contents
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE asset_contents (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	hash VARCHAR(256), 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	path TEXT NOT NULL, 
	mtime_ns BIGINT, 
	is_missing BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_asset_contents PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_asset_contents_ck_asset_contents_size_nonneg CHECK (size_bytes >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_asset_contents_ck_asset_contents_mtime_nonneg CHECK (mtime_ns >= 0)
)

schema.name: asset_system_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE asset_system_state (
	"key" VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_asset_system_state PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

schema.name: asset_tags
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE asset_tags (
	asset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tag_name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	added_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_asset_tags PRIMARY KEY (asset_id, tag_name), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_asset_tags_asset_id_assets FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_asset_tags_tag_name_tags FOREIGN KEY(tag_name) REFERENCES tags (name) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

schema.name: assets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE assets (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	content_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(255), 
	system_metadata JSON, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	user_metadata JSON, 
	loader_path TEXT, 
	preview_id VARCHAR(36), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_access_time DATETIME, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_assets PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assets_content_id_asset_contents FOREIGN KEY(content_id) REFERENCES asset_contents (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_assets_preview_id_assets FOREIGN KEY(preview_id) REFERENCES assets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

schema.name: tags
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" (name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_tags PRIMARY KEY (name))
